capabilities: Set the default open mode for existing notes (reading, live preview, source, or unchanged)
Set the default open mode for newly created notes
Add exceptions by file, folder, or glob pattern with first-match-wins ordering
Add the current note to exceptions via a command and settings button
Localize settings and commands in eight languages
extras: The README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data; only Markdown notes are affected and tab switching never overrides the mode.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in whatever mode was last used and gives no per-file or per-folder control over whether an existing or newly created note starts in reading or editing view.
summary: Control which view mode notes open in: existing notes and new notes can each default to reading view, live preview, or source mode, with exceptions per file, folder, or glob pattern.
